qa_item: Yearly green_mask-NDVI Pearson correlations all positive
interpretation: Checks whether Otsu green percentage generally tracks continuous NDVI cross-sectionally within each year.
Low/negative values would indicate poor same-year alignment in at least one year.

qa_item: Green TWFE sign reverses after adding controls
interpretation: If True, positive V3 result may involve suppression/sign reversal induced by the control set.

qa_item: Full-control green_mask and NDVI response signs agree
interpretation: If False, Otsu-derived green percentage and continuous vegetation index tell different longitudinal stories.

qa_item: green_mask, NDVI and EVI full-control signs all agree
interpretation: Cross-indicator consistency check only; not causal proof.
Aggregated CSV cannot establish fixed-vs-year-specific Otsu thresholds. Source code/log must be manually verified.
